task: Aegis pilot: register agent skill (G4, Agent Productization Rule)
prompt: Register the aegis-pilot CLI as a skill. Read docs/DWS_SKILLS_GUIDE.md, skills/manifest.json and two existing skills/<name>/SKILL.md files first and match their format exactly. Create skills/aegis-pilot/SKILL.md: when to use (rehearse, run acceptance, stop an agent, verify evidence for DWS-AEGIS-PILOT-001), inputs (state dir, scope), each CLI command with its JSON output and exit codes (see the header of scripts/aegis-pilot.ts), and hard rules: acceptance runs need a human operator and named witness; never place the operator key in the state dir; a NEGATIVE_RESULT is a valid outcome and is reported, not retried away. Add the manifest entry, then run 'npm run skills:sync-guide' and 'npm run skills:check' and commit what they change. Do not touch package.json or package-lock.json. prettier --write changed files; commit and push.

checks.name: skill registered and checks pass
checks.run: test -f skills/aegis-pilot/SKILL.md && grep -q '"aegis-pilot"' skills/manifest.json && npm run -s skills:check >/dev/null
